items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: " Early Autumn." " Early Autumn." It was Woody Herman, with Woody Herman.

ctx.x: And he went on from there. Of course, he got a chance during later years to do his own thing. You know what happened from there on. Stan, this thing that he made was in the DownBeat, one of his solos -- da-da-da-da-da-dee-da-da, da-da-da-da --
" Early Autumn." " Early Autumn." It was Woody Herman, with Woody Herman.

"Early Autumn" -- that thing was (Inaudible) published, that. Do you remember a guy that used to write for the DownBeat, the musical column of Chicago. He was connected with (inaudible) from named Sharon Pease?
